clips.title: The story
paras: On Thunder Bluff's mesas, Bluff Runner Windstrider carries urgent messages across the city. He directs Horde travelers toward distant frontiers, including Ashenvale, Feralas, and the Plaguelands.

Bluff Runner Windstrider carries messages across Thunder Bluff's high plateaus. His swift runs keep the city's leaders and visitors informed. He jogs along the rope bridges and pathways, calling out news and carrying dispatches. When outposts across Kalimdor or the Eastern Kingdoms need reinforcements, Windstrider calls on passing champions to carry word and answer the call to arms.

Bluff Runner Windstrider's messages reach far beyond Mulgore. He sends adventurers north to join Senani Thunderheart's great hunt at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. He points seasoned scouts south toward Camp Mojache in Feralas and carries grave warnings about the ongoing undead menace in the Western Plaguelands. His dispatches connect Mulgore's tribal heart to the wider conflicts of the Horde.
